latest_release.name: v0.10.0: Websockets/Realtime API, CPU Memory & API Keys
latest_release.body:
Curated summary: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/blob/v0.10.0/CHANGELOG.md)
* feat(api): add ElevenLabs and Cartesia compatible websocket TTS for voice agents by @remsky in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/576
* feat(api): add OpenAI Realtime compatible TTS on /v1/realtime, Speech endpoint fields on all websockets by @remsky in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/584
* fix(docker): preload jemalloc in the CPU image to reduce + keep memory flat by @YaannnTech in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/595
* feat(api): optional API keys for the API routes by @davidcoulson in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/568
* fix(api): map OpenAI voices marin, cedar, verse and ballad by @remsky in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/578
* fix(api): reject a download_format that differs from response_format by @davidcoulson in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/570
* fix(api): only check download_format when a download link is requested by @Alvi-Rahman in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/585
* fix: return a short silence for input with nothing to speak (#579) by @Kiddo4993 in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/580
* fix(api): send websocket silence once per context, keep empty input with alias rate a 400 by @remsky in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/590
* ci(test): apt install on runners skip ffmpeg and cmake by @remsky in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/592
* fix(docker): bake Kokoro weights from the Hub as primary with config GET comparison, keep old method as fallback by @remsky in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/596
* docs(skills): add downstream consumer check skill with helper script by @remsky in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/583
* build(deps): bump the actions group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/581
* ci(test): fail a stalled apt install after 5 minutes by @remsky in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/591

## New Contributors
* @Alvi-Rahman made their first contribution in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/585
* @Kiddo4993 made their first contribution in https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/pull/580

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remsky/Kokoro-FastAPI/compare/v0.9.2...v0.10.0
